name: chest-container-clicks
comment: WP-2.5. ContainerChest over the double chest BlockChest.blockActivated would open at (-2,61,0) (InventoryLargeChest("Large chest", chest(-2,61,0), chest(-2,61,1)): slots 0-26 the first chest, 27-53 the second, 54-80 main inventory, 81-89 hotbar) and over the single chest at (-2,61,4) (0-26 chest, 27-53 main, 54-62 hotbar). A player (id 0) on a stone floor; each use_item puts a stack into hotbar slot 0 and right-clicks a workbench (not used). One op per tick from t=1: 64 cobblestone picked up, one put into chest slot 0 twice with right clicks, the rest into slot 30 (the second chest's slot 3); 10 sticks shift-clicked into the chest (ContainerChest.getStackInSlot: mergeItemStack 0..54, first empty slot 1); slot 30 shift-clicked to the player (mergeItemStack 54..90 from the end: hotbar slot 8); 10 cobblestone shift-clicked onto chest slot 0 (top-up to 12), then the 62 from hotbar 8 (slot 0 topped up to 64, the remaining 10 into the first empty slot 2); 3 diamonds into the single chest's slot 13 (a new container: the spec changed), half of them picked up with a right click ((3+1)/2 = 2) and the last one shift-clicked to the player's main inventory; back in the double chest (a new container again) slot 2 clicked with the 2 diamonds still held (a swap: the held stack goes in, the 10 cobblestone come out) and the cobblestone put into slot 50 (the second chest's 23); sticks and cobblestone swapped between slots 1 and 0 through the cursor. Then the save op (Tier S): chunk (-1,0) with the three chests' Items lists; the inventory dump after every tick and rng_state at the end.
